source.author: The Milelator
source.title: The ULTIMATE SION MID GUIDE | Master 400 lp Player | ALL MATCH UPS

fields: You are stronger for the first three levels, so freeze or perma-push and help your jungler. Once she has a few levels and some AP you will rarely kill her, and she clears waves fast from around 80 AP. Later, peel for your carries by slowing her with E and ulting into her during her ultimate.

Her poke is annoying; stay healthy and keep a healthy minion between you to block charm. A good Ahri cannot be killed 1v1, so push and roam from level 6. Unless she builds Liandry's she will not kill you, and Force of Nature is strong against her.

You are stronger at every stage. Freeze to deny her farm, bait her E and shroud then E into ultimate to force Flash, or push and roam since her early wave clear is poor. Late game she cannot kill you, though she is too mobile to catch easily.

Second Wind and Doran's Shield let you sustain through his poke, but gaining priority costs health. You clear waves better; if he uses his E and you land yours, ult in to force his Flash. Late he only threatens with lethality items and skill, and cannot stop your side-lane tower pushing.

One of Sion's worst counters. You can sometimes stun her before she recasts her Q, but she clears better after 6, her wall interrupts your Q and ultimate, and Liandry's makes her hurt. Ban her if you blind pick; Ghost helps.

She will poke with her long auto range and Q at the cost of minion aggro and mana; Doran's Shield helps you stay healthy. You out-push her throughout, and at 6 you can all-in with your slow to force Flash. Ult her in late fights to keep her off your carries.

Your early game is much stronger; push and roam since freezing does not work. His E moves your charging Q, which can surprise him. Trade whenever your E lands. After he has an item or two, focus other lanes and objectives and peel.
Lots of early poke. You can trade before 6, then push and roam. All-ins risk him ulting you into his tower, but you clear faster and roam better with your ultimate; Doran's Shield is a must.
She is strong against Sion and you must outplay her. Rush Mercury's Treads and only trade when your E lands. After 6 push and roam, since she outscales you.

Very easy; he is only strong at four or more items. Use your wave clear for mid priority, roam and take objectives, and all-in when he uses his W. Without Liandry's he cannot stop your tower pushing; peel if he dives your backline with his package.
She cannot kill you unless very fed. Trade with E, push and roam. Her ultimate is the one thing that cancels your Q, but her damage on you is limited; Plated Steelcaps work well.
You clear faster and trade fairly when your Q stun lands; he will not kill you unless you misplay. Once he can push with Q and roam, match the roam, take the wave or take towers.
Easy: you have better wave clear and poke. Trade whenever Q is up and deny his last hits, all-in after he uses E, and keep your shield for his ultimate.

If you stun him with Q before his E lands, you win trades. He roams whenever his ultimate is up, so follow or punish with towers. He should not be able to all-in you, and you should not all-in him unless the kill is certain.

Usually played by one-tricks; annoying with strong push. With some levels and health, trade by hitting him with his own turrets in your Q. If he wins trades, push and roam or call your jungler, since your E guarantees Flash or a kill.

A skill matchup: dodge her stun and you likely win the trade. Q your low minions to deny her farm. Once she has Blade of the Ruined King she kills you, so either stomp her early or play for the team. Bramble Vest first and Plated Steelcaps are recommended.
His early poke is annoying, but you can all-in him fairly easily. With some armor he cannot burst you and will go for your carries instead. Push and roam.
One of the easiest lanes. Trade constantly with E and all-in with your ultimate after hitting E. Use your priority to help jungle and bot.
Very easy. Dodge his Q and trade with E, Q and W; after 6 you can all-in. Use your constant priority for objectives, cancel his ultimate with your ultimate or Q, and buy early boots.
Before 6 you can do anything: push, deny, take towers or roam. After 6 you will not kill him unless he misplays, and he will not kill you until two items or level 11 to 16. Push and roam.

A good LeBlanc is nearly unkillable for you, but her poke barely matters with Doran's Shield, Second Wind and your W shield. Push and play for the team, or take towers since her early wave clear is weak.
You can always trade but cannot all-in with your ultimate. Use better wave clear for priority, and take towers if she roams. She cannot kill you even with Liandry's.
You have priority before 6, so try to kill her then. Afterward she pushes with her low-cooldown ultimate and roams; you clear fast enough to follow. She will never kill you.
One of Sion's easiest lanes. Keep his shield down and trade constantly; his voidlings can be slowed and you can ult him. Soak his E with your shields, deny his push, and tower dive once he is low.
Neither of you can kill the other. Doran's Shield is a must; push and roam.
AD assassins do little to you if you play well. Trade and push; do not dive or all-in while her abilities are up.
Fair but annoying; she is hard to kill but cannot stop your push without her ultimate. Push and roam.
A top-tier mid with no terrible matchups. With Phase Rush, trades are very hard to win, so use your push for priority and help other lanes.
Check her mastery; a non-specialist loses lane to you. Against a skilled one, avoid walls and remember her E puts her behind you. Push and roam if not confident.
Only trade when his W prison is down. You can all-in with E and ultimate to burn his Flash, then push and roam.
He stacks on you, but his W and E have long cooldowns. Stand in front of minions to avoid his E pull. Trade freely until he has Liandry's, after which his healing wins 1v1s; you still out-push him.
Early game is yours. Dodge his chain or stand behind minions and trade often, since his early cooldowns are long and mana costly. Mid to late, he wins on even gold while he has mana.
Her E-Q stun interrupts your push and damage, and Liandry's makes her very strong against you. Survive and dodge before 6; at 6, land E and all-in to force Flash, otherwise push and roam.
Harass him at level 1 and deny his level 2. Trade when Q is up and respect his W-Q-auto burst; use E slow and Q range. If he roams, take plates or towers.
Bait out her W, then trade or push and roam. If she roams a lot, take plates and towers. With Luden's she does little to you late.
A skill matchup; trade and try to Q-stun her as she jumps. Her ultimate can knock you away and cancel your Q.
Survive the first two levels, trade from 3, and all-in at 6 to burn Flash. You cannot answer his roams without Teleport, so cancel him with Flash-ultimate or push and take plates.

He stacks on you, but you have better wave clear and early trades. Avoid being caged while charging Q, and learn the spacing where the cage only traps you. Your ultimate passes through the cage for all-ins.
His early poke is weak. Dodge his Q and E stun and push. Trade with E slow, and kill him if he ults you or stands close without Flash; later cancel his ultimate with yours.
Her fear is annoying, though you have no dashes for her to punish. Trade when the fear is down and all-in with E into ultimate. You push better, so roam or take towers if she does.

Avoid poke, trade when your E lands, and remember his W takes time to stun and his ultimate cancels your Q. Force Flash or kill him with E into ultimate when he is low. Wave clear evens out once he has an item and empowered E.
Trading is pointless since he heals it back; use your far stronger push for priority and objectives. Do not buy anti-heal yourself; leave it to a damage dealer.
Stand behind minions to dodge his E and dodge everything else. Trade or all-in when your E lands; if his E hits you, he wins unless you ult in to force Flash. Push and roam.

A skill matchup; predict his movement to land slow and stun. His wind wall blocks your E, but not a minion knocked by it. With no wave, all-in with slow into ultimate; once he has Blade he beats you unless you are far ahead.
Trade constantly and keep priority. Dodge his Q and he will not kill you. Do not ult into him while his ultimate is up; take plates or roam instead.
One of the strongest mids and a good ban. You cannot push or trade properly unless he is worse than you. Trade or all-in when his W is down, and wait for his early mana problems before pressing.
Trade behind minions; if you dodge her sleep she is not a problem. Push and play for the team, or take towers if she roams.
Like Yasuo, but you cannot all-in with ultimate; trade with your basic spells. If he ults you, ult the opposite way to stun him. With Blade he beats you and outscales.
